name: bgwriter_flush_after
description: Number of pages after which the background writer forces OS-level write flushes to disk to reduce transaction latency and avoid large write bursts.
tuning_tips: Increase cautiously on systems with fast storage (e.g., NVMe) to smooth I/O; reduce or set to 0 on slower storage or when OS-level write coalescing is preferred. Monitor 'pg_stat_bgwriter' for 'buffers_written' patterns and 'write' vs 'flush' timing.
